en: An illustrated view of a European old town square with cobblestone streets and gabled houses. The buildings have steep red-tiled roofs and light-colored facades, with some shopfronts at street level. In the background rises a tall, slender church spire in Baroque style. The perspective shows a quiet intersection of streets framed by historic merchant houses. There is a small signature of the artist at the bottom.
